items.title: Energy Stored in an Inductor (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Energy Stored in an Inductor: a main subheading of 17.16 Self Induction, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 111-113.

blocks.text: Ek coil battery aur switch ke saath series mein lagi hai (Fig. 17.19). Switch ON karne par coil par voltage lagta hai aur current zero se barh kar maximum tak jata hai. Current badalne se coil mein battery ke ulat emf paida hoti hai. Is ulti emf ke against (khilaf) charges ko chalane ke liye battery work (kaam) karti hai.

blocks.alt: Switch ke zariye battery se juri coil; current I coil ke aik sire mein jata aur doosre se nikalta. Coil ke dono siron se magnetic field lines phailti hain. Mura hua red teer induced current dikhata hai jo I ke barhne ko oppose karta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.19: Inductor mein stored energy maloom karne ka circuit (kitab ki Figure 17.19 ke mutabiq original drawing).

Yahan ε_L self-induced emf ki magnitude (miqdar) hai:

blocks.latex: W = \Delta q L\frac{\Delta I}{\Delta t} = \frac{\Delta q}{\Delta t}L\Delta I \tag{17.35}
blocks.text_alt: W = Δq L ΔI/Δt = (Δq/Δt) L ΔI   (17.35)

blocks.text: Yahan Δq/Δt average current hai. Current 0 se barh kar I tak jata hai, is liye average:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan (0+1)/2 chhapti hai; sahi (0 + I)/2 = ½I hai (1 nahi, current I).
Yeh work inductor mein potential energy ban kar store ho jata hai:

Yaad rahe: inductor mein energy magnetic field mein jama hoti hai aur kabhi negative nahi hoti, kyunke yeh current ke square ke mutabiq hai. Inductor power lete waqt energy jama karta hai aur power dete waqt wahi energy wapas karta hai. Ab Eq. 17.37 ko solenoid ke magnetic field B ki shakal mein likhte hain:

items: n = per unit length turns ki number
A = coil ke cross-section ka area
B = solenoid ka magnetic field = μₒnI
L = self-inductance = μₒn²Al, jahan l solenoid ki length hai

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab is list mein B ko 'Negative field' likhti hai (sahi: solenoid ka magnetic field) aur current ko B/μₒnI likhti hai (ek I zyada); sahi I = B/μₒn hai.
Eq. 17.37 mein yeh qeematen rakhne se:

blocks.text_alt: As Al = volume, so Uₘ = B² (1/2μₒ)(volume)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab is line mein Uₘ/volume = (1/μₒ)B² chhapti hai, yani 2 reh gaya. Sahi B²/(2μₒ) hai, jaisa oopar wali line aur Eq. 17.38 dikhati hain.
Solenoid ke andar per unit volume stored energy Uₘ ko energy density kehte hain:

blocks.prompt: 0.5 H ke inductor mein 2 A current ho to kitni energy jama hai?
blocks.explanation: Uₘ = ½LI² = ½ × 0.5 H × (2 A)² = 1 J.

items: Self-induction: Nφ = LI; ε_L = −L ΔI/Δt (minus: change ko oppose karti hai).
L turns, area aur core par depend karti hai; 1 H = 1 V s A⁻¹.
Energy Uₘ = ½LI²; energy density = B²/(2μₒ).
